source.title: Exploring Calendar Anomalies and Volatility Dynamics in Cryptocurrencies: A Comparative Analysis of Day-of-the-Week Effects before and during the COVID-19 Pandemic
source.paper_daily_close_semantics: The paper describes crypto daily closing prices as based on a specific point in time each day, usually the end of the UTC day; CoinMarketCap aggregates across exchanges.
source.paper_return_definition: R_n = ln(CP_n) - ln(CP_(n-1)), multiplied by 100; CP_n is the closing price on day n and CP_(n-1) the previous day's close.

boundary_translation.source_return_interval_interpretation: previous UTC-day close -> Tuesday UTC-day close
boundary_translation.project_price_proxy: OKX ETH-USDT-SWAP 1H bar open at each exact UTC boundary

scientific_interpretation.finding: The already-frozen Tuesday 00:00 -> Wednesday 00:00 project interval is aligned with the paper's end-of-UTC-day close-to-close definition of a Tuesday return; no one-day boundary correction is warranted.
